trap.label: falso cognato
trap.wrong: The headline infers that the minister lied.
trap.right: The headline implies that the minister lied.
trap.why: Em português “inferir” é confundido com sugerir; infer é do receptor, imply é do emissor.

mcq.q: The writer **___** a link without stating it.
The reader **___** a link from the text.

fix.wrong: I implied from his tone that he was upset.
fix.right: I inferred from his tone that he was upset.

fix.wrong: Are you inferring that I am late?
fix.right: Are you implying that I am late?

fix.why: Data costuma ser plural no registro formal.

rewrite.prompt: Troque “implies” por “infers”, sujeito “I”: “The text implies a flaw.”
rewrite.answer: I infer a flaw from the text.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com “suggest”: “The survey hints at a pattern.”
